intent: Support all requested functions with isolated input roots: primary_use mines through the item tool and spawns only a straight damaging projectile; alternate_use spawns only the boomerang-like returning projectile. A held-only generated effect group refreshes ore detection and modest life regeneration; it occupies neither active input and grants no defense. Include configure_weapon_ammo because configure_spawn declares it as a dependency, but the brief does not request ammunition consumption, so do not infer it.
